dialogues.speaker: Yegor
dialogues.text: Huh? You heard that? Oh, that's problematic, um...

dialogues.speaker: Yegor
dialogues.text: But judging by your gear, you seem like a seasoned adventurer... Well, then I'll be honest with you.

dialogues.speaker: Yegor
dialogues.text: I have a friend who has been to Inazuma before. He told me a lot of legends about the treasures in Inazuma. He also mentioned a lot of places, like Konda Village or whatever that place is called...

dialogues.speaker: Yegor
dialogues.text: If you've got some contacts, could you help me ask around?
